newsitem.title: DUBAI: Afghan cabbie arrested for rape, murder in Iran.
newsitem.headline: Afghan cabbie arrested for rape, murder in Iran.

text.p: An Afghan taxi driver has been arrested in Iran on charges of kidnapping, raping and killing at least 11 young women in the capital Tehran, the daily Tehran Times reported on Monday.
The English-language paper said the 28-year-old man was alleged to have burned the bodies of his victims after killing them so they would not be recognised.

He was previously arrested in 1993 on charges of raping a young girl, but managed to escape from police on the way to court. He fled back to Afghanistan, but is accused of returning to Iran illegally.
More than one million Afghan refugees live in Iran.
